intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE (CMT2EE) is caused by homozygous mutation in the MPV17 gene (137960) on chromosome 2p23.3.

checks.claim: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE (CMT2EE) is caused by homozygous mutation in the MPV17 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: We describe a patient presenting with a severe peripheral neuropathy, leukoencephalopathy and liver involvement due to a homozygous MPV17 gene mutation leading to multiple mtDNA deletions and focal COX deficiency in skeletal muscle.
checks.explanation: The paper links a homozygous MPV17 mutation to axonal neuropathy in one patient. It never names the disorder Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE, and the patient also had leukoencephalopathy.

checks.claim: The MPV17 gene is located on chromosome 2p23.3.
checks.evidence_quote: mutations in MPV17 are associated with hepatocerebral mtDNA depletion but the function of the mpv17 protein remains uncertain
checks.explanation: The paper does not state the chromosomal location. This is standard gene nomenclature, which the rules accept as supported.

paragraphs.text: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE (CMT2EE) is an autosomal recessive axonal sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy (Choi et al., 2015). Onset is in childhood or later (Baumann et al., 2019). Patients have distal muscle weakness and atrophy, mainly in the lower limbs (Choi et al., 2015), and distal sensory loss (Blakely et al., 2012). Some patients have features suggesting mitochondrial dysfunction (Blakely et al., 2012). Other mutations in MPV17 cause a severe infantile hepatocerebral mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome, which includes Navajo neurohepatopathy (Blakely et al., 2012).

checks.claim: CMT2EE is an autosomal recessive axonal sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy.
checks.evidence_quote: This study enrolled two autosomal recessive Korean families with axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy (FC26 and FC355, Fig. 1a).
checks.explanation: The paper describes autosomal recessive axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy caused by a homozygous MPV17 mutation, which is the phenotype the draft calls CMT2EE.

checks.claim: Onset of CMT2EE is in childhood or later.
checks.evidence_quote: MPV17 mutations in juvenile- and adult-onset axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy.
checks.explanation: The title states juvenile and adult onset, which matches onset in childhood or later.

checks.claim: Patients with CMT2EE have distal muscle weakness and atrophy, mainly in the lower limbs.
checks.evidence_quote: Neurologic examination at the age of 34 years revealed muscle weakness and atrophies of bilateral, distal muscles, predominantly in the lower limbs.
checks.explanation: Distal weakness and atrophy are reported in both patients. The lower-limb predominance is stated explicitly for patient 1, and both patients had severe lower-leg atrophy.

checks.claim: Patients with CMT2EE have distal sensory loss.
checks.evidence_quote: Sensory examination was normal in the upper limbs, but revealed decreased perception of pin-prick and light touch distal to the knees, impaired vibration sense to the ankles and absent joint position sense at the toes.
checks.explanation: The patient had distal sensory loss, and nerve conduction studies confirmed an axonal sensory motor polyneuropathy.

checks.claim: Some patients with CMT2EE have features suggesting mitochondrial dysfunction.
checks.evidence_quote: Importantly, histochemical analysis demonstrated clear evidence of muscle involvement with ragged red fibres and a mosaic pattern of COX deficiency.
checks.explanation: The patient had ragged-red fibres, COX deficiency, multiple mtDNA deletions and raised CSF lactate, all of which indicate mitochondrial dysfunction.

checks.claim: Other mutations in MPV17 cause a severe infantile hepatocerebral mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: mutation of MPV17 - a gene implicated in severe, infantile hepatocerebral mtDNA depletion disorders characterised by a loss of mtDNA copies - can also cause clonally-expanded mtDNA deletion

checks.claim: The MPV17-related severe infantile hepatocerebral mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome includes Navajo neurohepatopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: Infantile NNH is an early onset, fatal form of hepatocerebral depletion syndrome while the mildest (classic) form of NNH is characterised by moderate liver dysfunction
checks.explanation: The paper associates Navajo neurohepatopathy with the MPV17 p.Arg50Gln mutation and describes its infantile form as a hepatocerebral depletion syndrome.

paragraphs.text: Choi et al. (2015) reported autosomal recessive transmission of CMT2EE.

checks.evidence_quote: a novel homozygous mutation c.122G> A (p.R41Q) in MPV17 was identified in both families (Fig. 1b). A mutant allele was putatively inherited from each parent in both families.
checks.explanation: The paper reports homozygous mutations inherited from unaffected parents in two families it calls autosomal recessive.

paragraphs.text: Blakely et al. (2012) identified a homozygous mutation in the MPV17 gene in a patient with severe axonal peripheral neuropathy.

checks.claim: Blakely et al. (2012) identified a homozygous MPV17 mutation in a patient with severe axonal peripheral neuropathy.
checks.evidence_quote: We describe a patient presenting with a severe peripheral neuropathy, leukoencephalopathy and liver involvement due to a homozygous MPV17 gene mutation
checks.explanation: Nerve conduction studies confirmed an axonal sensory motor polyneuropathy, and the sural nerve biopsy showed a severe chronic axonal neuropathy.

paragraphs.text: Baumann et al. (2019) found homozygous mutations in the MPV17 gene in patients with juvenile- or adult-onset axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy. The mutations included a recurrent arg41-to-gln (R41Q) substitution.

checks.claim: Baumann et al. (2019) found homozygous MPV17 mutations in patients with juvenile- or adult-onset axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy.
checks.evidence_quote: we describe five additional patients from two unrelated families with sensorimotor axonal neuropathy without hepatocerebral affection caused by homozygous MPV17 variants
checks.explanation: The abstract states that patients with this neuropathy carried homozygous MPV17 variants.

checks.claim: The MPV17 mutations found by Baumann et al. (2019) in patients with axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy included a recurrent R41Q (arg41-to-gln) substitution.
checks.evidence_quote: Patients of the first family carried the known c.122G>A variant
checks.explanation: The abstract says this variant, c.122G>A (p.Arg41Gln), was reported before, so it is recurrent.
